# VinaX

> Free music-streaming web app and Android app for India. Browse Home, charts, new releases, radio, podcasts and every song, album and artist page without signing in; sign in with Google (one tap) to play, like, save and keep your library on every device. No subscription, no premium tier, no ads in the player. Tuned for Indian languages: Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Punjabi, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali, Marathi, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Urdu and English. Recommendations run on your device, with no AI.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/): Trending now, charts, new releases and shelves arranged for you
- [Search](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/search): Songs, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts and lyrics lines
- [Discover](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/discover): Charts, languages, moods, regions, films, radio and podcasts
- [Top Charts](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/charts): The most played songs by language, updated daily
- [Top Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/top-songs) · [Popular](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/trending) · [Most Searched](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/most-searched)
- [New Releases](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/new-releases): The newest songs and albums as they land
- [Top Playlists](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/top-playlists) · [Top Artists](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/top-artists)
- [Radio](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/radio): Endless music from a song, an artist, a mood or a station
- [Podcasts](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/podcasts): Shows and conversations
- [Movies](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/movies): Film soundtracks
- [Moods](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/moods): Music by mood
- [Videos](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/videos): Music videos
- [Made For You](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/made-for-you): Personal mixes from your listening
- [Your Week](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/weekly): A personalised weekly mix, new every Monday (signed in)
- [VinaX AI](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/vinaxai): The chat assistant for signed-in listeners
- [Get the app](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/download): The Android app (background play, offline downloads, widgets)
- [About](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/about) · [Help](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/help) · [Privacy](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/privacy) · [Terms](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/terms) · [Contact](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/contact) · [Copyright & takedowns](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/dmca)

- [English Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/english-songs)
- [Punjabi Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/punjabi-songs)
- [Kannada Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/kannada-songs)
- [Malayalam Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/malayalam-songs)
- [Bengali Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/bengali-songs)
- [Marathi Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/marathi-songs)
- [Bhojpuri Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/bhojpuri-songs)
- [Gujarati Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/gujarati-songs)
- [Urdu Songs](https://www.vinaxmusic.online/urdu-songs)

Each language also has mood pages at /{language}-{mood}-songs for romantic, sad, party, devotional, melody and workout (for example /telugu-romantic-songs). Song, album, artist, playlist and lyrics pages live at /song/{id}, /album/{id}, /artist/{id}, /playlist/{id} and /lyrics/{id}; the sitemap at /sitemap.xml lists the built ones.

## What a listener can do

- Tap any song and Up Next fills itself five songs at a time, led by that song's language and mood, never repeating what you have heard; songs you queue yourself play first. Familiar, Balanced or Discover sets how adventurous it is; Tune this queue pins a mood.
- Signed in: Home shelves made for you on your device ("Made for you", "Because you liked…", your languages, discoveries), a weekly mix, Discover 5 unheard songs a day, badges and listening stats.
- Search by title, artist, album or a line of lyrics; synced lyrics with romanised text; karaoke mode.
- One "Music languages" button in the top bar changes Home, charts, radio and search together.
- Five reactions under every song; follow artists and see their new songs first on the Following page; share playlists as public pages; Listen Together rooms with a link, QR code or room code.
- Appearance: six app styles (Lumen, Verdant, Monsoon, Harbour, Verse, Onyx), dark, light, true-black, system or automatic themes, any accent colour, and an app language of English, Telugu, Hindi or Tamil.
- Android app: background playback, lock-screen and headset controls, home-screen widgets, offline downloads, push notifications and in-app updates. On an iPhone, Add to Home Screen keeps music playing with the screen off.
- Back up the library and settings to one file, restore it, or move to a new device with a one-time code.
- Ideas & bugs: the lightbulb in the top bar opens a popup to suggest a feature or report a bug; it names your device for you.

## Notes

- VinaX is free: no subscription, no premium tier.
- Browsing needs no account. Playing, liking and saving ask for a Google sign-in; there is no password.
- Favourites, playlists, history and the on-device taste profile stay on the listener's device; a signed-in listener's copy syncs to the account.
- Audio and artwork come from public music catalogues and are not hosted by VinaX. Rights holders can use /dmca.
- Canonical origin is https://www.vinaxmusic.online (with www). A machine-readable catalogue of the pages is at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json.
